# Generated by tools/generate.py from territorial_doctrine/rules.json.
td_clear_success_modifiers_effect = {
    remove_modifier = td_success_historical_rights
    remove_modifier = td_success_strategic_frontiers
    remove_modifier = td_success_imperial_expansion
    remove_modifier = td_success_admission
}

# STATE: activation takes a snapshot once, never on every save load.
td_register_original_territory_effect = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = td_original_owner } }
        set_variable = { name = td_original_owner value = owner }
    }
}
# COUNTRY, PREV = the state whose ownership changed. Keep the reward lock after
# a setback, so recapturing the same territory cannot restart the three years.
td_revoke_success_on_prev_state_effect = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = td_success_state var:td_success_state = prev }
        td_clear_success_modifiers_effect = yes
        remove_variable = td_success_state
    }
}
# COUNTRY: transfers and deleted state objects also invalidate credit on pulse.
td_refresh_success_credit_effect = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = td_success_state }
        if = { limit = { OR = {
            NOT = { exists = var:td_success_state }
            var:td_success_state = { NOT = { owner = root } }
            NOT = { has_variable = td_success_window }
        } }
            td_clear_success_modifiers_effect = yes
            remove_variable = td_success_state
        }
    }
}
# COUNTRY, PREV = the acquired state. Claims alone earn nothing.
td_award_acquisition_success_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            td_feature_enabled_trigger = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = td_success_window }
            has_claim = prev.state_region
            is_target_in_variable_list = { name = td_approved_claim_regions target = prev.state_region }
            NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = td_renounced_regions target = prev.state_region } }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_td_historical_rights }
            td_clear_success_modifiers_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = td_success_window months = 36 }
            set_variable = { name = td_success_state value = prev }
            add_modifier = { name = td_success_historical_rights months = 36 }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_td_strategic_frontiers }
            td_clear_success_modifiers_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = td_success_window months = 36 }
            set_variable = { name = td_success_state value = prev }
            add_modifier = { name = td_success_strategic_frontiers months = 36 }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_law = law_type:law_td_imperial_expansion }
            td_clear_success_modifiers_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = td_success_window months = 36 }
            set_variable = { name = td_success_state value = prev }
            add_modifier = { name = td_success_imperial_expansion months = 36 }
        }
    }
}

# COUNTRY: an actually completed individual admission, not a vote or timer start.
td_award_admission_success_effect = {
    if = { limit = { td_feature_enabled_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = td_success_window } }
        td_clear_success_modifiers_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = td_success_window months = 36 }
        set_variable = { name = td_success_state value = var:td_target }
        add_modifier = { name = td_success_admission months = 36 }
    }
}
# STATE: only a sovereign acquisition can fire this reaction, once per owner.
td_process_acquisition_effect = {
    if = { limit = { td_feature_enabled_trigger = yes is_treaty_port = no owner = { td_has_doctrine_trigger = yes }
        has_variable = td_acquired_owner var:td_acquired_owner = owner
        NOT = { AND = { has_variable = td_acquisition_reaction_owner var:td_acquisition_reaction_owner = owner } }
    }
        if = { limit = { td_development_target_trigger = yes }
            if = { limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_td_status_quo } }
                add_loyalists_in_state = { value = 0.02 }
            }
            if = { limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_td_historical_rights } }
                add_radicals_in_state = { value = 0.01 }
                add_loyalists_in_state = { value = 0.02 }
            }
            if = { limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_td_strategic_frontiers } }
                add_radicals_in_state = { value = 0.03 }
                add_loyalists_in_state = { value = 0.01 }
            }
            if = { limit = { owner = { has_law = law_type:law_td_imperial_expansion } }
                add_radicals_in_state = { value = 0.05 }
            }
        }
        owner = { td_award_acquisition_success_effect = yes }
        set_variable = { name = td_acquisition_reaction_owner value = owner }
    }
}
# STATE: ratification affects this state's residents, never the entire country.
td_admission_reaction_effect = {
    if = { limit = { td_feature_enabled_trigger = yes has_variable = td_admitted_owner
        var:td_admitted_owner = owner
        NOT = { AND = { has_variable = td_admission_reaction_owner var:td_admission_reaction_owner = owner } }
    }
        if = { limit = { root = { var:td_reason = 3 } }
            add_radicals_in_state = { value = -0.03 }
            add_loyalists_in_state = { value = 0.03 }
        }
        else = {
            add_radicals_in_state = { value = -0.02 }
            add_loyalists_in_state = { value = 0.02 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = td_admission_reaction_owner value = owner }
    }
}
